summary_en: 600,700 shares to be cancelled (2.8% of shares outstanding). Effective date brought forward to 31-Jul-2026 from originally scheduled 15-Oct-2026. Acquisition completed early within 14-May to 30-Sep-2026 window at aggregate yen1,499.9M.
title_en: Notice of Change to Scheduled Cancellation Date of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 26 June 2026, GLOBERIDE announced a change to the scheduled cancellation date of treasury shares. The company had previously announced on 13 May 2026 a program to acquire up to 900,000 shares (4.1% of shares outstanding) for up to yen1.5 billion via market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during 14 May to 30 September 2026. Acquisition completed ahead of schedule with a total of 600,700 shares acquired at an aggregate cost of yen1,499.9 million. The cancellation date has been moved forward from the originally scheduled 15 October 2026 to 31 July 2026. All acquired shares are to be cancelled.
